title: Background Processing
description: Master agents, queues, job schedulers, and asynchronous processing for high-performance PEGA applications
objectives: Design job schedulers and batch jobs

content.introduction: Background processing is essential for handling long-running tasks, batch operations, and system maintenance without impacting user experience. This lesson covers PEGA's comprehensive background processing capabilities including agents, queues, and job schedulers.

sections.title: PEGA Agents Architecture
sections.content: Understand PEGA's agent architecture including standard agents, custom agents, agent scheduling, and resource management for background processing.

agents.description: Built-in agents for system maintenance and cleanup

sections.title: Queue-Based Processing
sections.content: Implement queue-based processing for handling high-volume, time-intensive operations. Understand queue management, priority processing, and error handling.

sections.title: Job Schedulers and Batch Jobs
sections.content: Design and implement job schedulers for recurring batch operations. Understand cron expressions, dependency management, and failure recovery.

sections.title: Asynchronous Workflows
sections.content: Implement asynchronous workflows that can handle long-running processes without blocking user interfaces. Understand callback mechanisms and status tracking.

sections.title: Performance Optimization
sections.content: Optimize background processing performance through efficient resource allocation, parallel processing, and intelligent scheduling.

sections.title: Monitoring and Troubleshooting
sections.content: Monitor background processing performance and troubleshoot common issues including agent failures, queue bottlenecks, and resource constraints.
